data.rationale: The proposal gets the same four-site sequence (Flights, Booking, Viator, Notes) and nearly all the parameters right, but it leaves out the 8+ review-score hotel rule, the "first/best flight" choice, the consent "Reject all" handling and the do-not-click constraints. It also says "cheapest or preferred" flight and "chosen hotel" without a rule, and it uses a different Viator query format ("{attraction} tour {destination}" instead of "{activity} {destination}"), so an automation would have to guess at several selection steps.
